name: modelibr-backup-restore-e2e
description: E2E tests for backup & restore - runs in an isolated docker-compose stack separate from the main e2e suite.

scripts.test:setup: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && node prepare-data-dirs.js && docker compose -f docker-compose.backup-e2e.yml up -d --build && node wait-for-services.js
scripts.test:teardown: docker compose -f docker-compose.backup-e2e.yml down -v && node clean-data.js
scripts.test:full: npm run test:setup && npm test; status=$?; npm run test:teardown; exit $status
